rules: Not supported as a distinct mechanism — no rules directory; AGENTS.md is the only project-rules channel (fold rules into it; 32 KiB merged cap, no include syntax).
subagents: Supported but NOT folder-discovered (no .kimi/agents/ convention): YAML agent spec files (version: 1; agent map with extend, name, system_prompt_path, system_prompt_args, tools=[Python module:Class paths], exclude_tools, subagents; source-only fields model, when_to_use, allowed_tools) loaded explicitly via --agent-file, or built-ins default/okabe via --agent. Subagents defined inline (subagents: {name: {path, description}}), each a full agent YAML, no nesting; built-in subagent types coder (read/write/shell), explore (no write tools but HAS Shell — not strictly read-only), plan (truly read-only, no Shell). Runtime state under session dir subagents/<agent_id>/.

hooks.config_file: .opencode/plugins/*.{js,ts} and ~/.config/opencode/plugins/*.{js,ts} (or npm names in plugin array of opencode.json)
hooks.format: JS/TS plugin modules run in-process (NOT shell commands); export async ({project, client, $, directory, worktree}) => ({hooks}); block by throwing, signal via output mutation; no matcher, no stdin envelope, no exit-code contract

subagents: Markdown files, one per agent: .opencode/agents/*.md (project) and ~/.config/opencode/agents/*.md (global); filename sans .md = agent name. YAML frontmatter: description (required), mode (primary|subagent|all), model, temperature, top_p, prompt (inline or {file:...}), steps, disable, hidden, color, permission (allow|ask|deny map), tools (deprecated); unknown keys pass through as model options. Body = system prompt. JSON alternative under agent key in opencode.json.
commands: Markdown files: .opencode/commands/*.md and ~/.config/opencode/commands/*.md; filename = slash-command name. Frontmatter: description, agent, model, subtask. Body = prompt template with $ARGUMENTS, positional $1/$2/..., !`cmd` shell injection, @file inlining. JSON alternative under command key in opencode.json (template required).
rules: Not a separate concept: rules = AGENTS.md files plus the instructions array (relative paths, globs, remote URLs) in opencode.json; any canonical rules/ dir must be folded into those.

mcp.file: mcp key inside opencode.json/opencode.jsonc (project root or ~/.config/opencode/); no separate MCP file
mcp.shape: map of name -> server object; local: {type:"local", command:[bin,...args] (single array), cwd, environment (NOT env), enabled, timeout ms}; remote: {type:"remote", url, headers, oauth, enabled, timeout}; {env:VAR} and {file:path} substitution anywhere

hazards: Hooks untranslatable as data: canonical matcher+shell-command hooks must be dropped or hand-rewritten as .opencode/plugins/*.js|ts; PreToolUse->tool.execute.before, PostToolUse->tool.execute.after, matching is imperative JS on input.tool, blocking = throw new Error, no stdin envelope/stdout/exit-code contract

Skill frontmatter: keep only name/description/license/compatibility/metadata; drop allowed-tools (silently ignored) and re-express as permission.skill globs in opencode.json, moving data out of the skill file into config

Skill naming: name must match ^[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*$ (1-64 chars) AND equal the directory name — slugify uppercase/underscore names and rename dirs; truncate description to 1024 chars; strict <name>/SKILL.md layout

MCP: JSON only (no TOML); merge command string + args into one command array; rename env -> environment; remote servers need explicit type:"remote" + url (no transport field); secrets become literals or {env:VAR} placeholders
Instructions: AGENTS.md has NO include/import syntax (@path is convention only) — flatten @import directives or enumerate extra files/globs/URLs in the instructions array of opencode.json

Subagents: dir is .opencode/agents/ (plural), filename becomes the agent name; convert canonical tools allow-lists to permission maps (allow|ask|deny, glob-capable; tools key deprecated); description frontmatter required; mode is primary|subagent|all

hooks.format: none — no shell-command hooks; JS/TS plugins (.kilo/plugin/*.ts, default export {id, server}) referenced via 'plugin' array in kilo.jsonc

subagents: Supported ('agents', subagent is a mode). Project .kilo/agents/*.md, global ~/.config/kilo/agents/*.md; filename minus .md = name. Markdown + YAML frontmatter, body = system prompt. Keys: description, mode (subagent|primary|all, default all), model, prompt (JSON only), temperature, top_p, permission (allow/ask/deny object), hidden, steps, color, disable. Alternate: 'agent' object in kilo.jsonc.
commands: Supported (docs call them 'workflows'). Project .kilo/commands/*.md, global ~/.config/kilo/commands/*.md; filename minus .md = /name. Markdown + optional YAML frontmatter keys: description, agent, model, subtask.
rules: Supported only via the 'instructions' array in kilo.jsonc (paths/globs/URLs) — files conventionally in .kilo/rules/*.md are NOT auto-discovered; dropping a file there does nothing unless registered. Plain text or Markdown, no frontmatter, no per-rule scoping. Only legacy .kilocode/rules/ auto-loads.

mcp.shape: 'mcp' key (not mcpServers); top-level key = server name. Local: {type:'local', command:[argv array], environment:{...}, enabled, timeout(ms, default 10000)}. Remote: {type:'remote', url, headers, enabled, timeout(15000), oauth:false}. MCP tools permissioned as {server}_{tool} with wildcards.

hazards: Hooks untranslatable 1:1: no PreToolUse/PostToolUse shell hooks, no matchers, no stdin JSON envelope, no exit codes. Drop hooks or emit .kilo/plugin/*.ts shims that DEFAULT-EXPORT {id, server} (id required for local files; bare-function exports only legacy). Map PreToolUse→tool.execute.before (block via throw), PostToolUse→tool.execute.after, permission hooks→permission.ask; matching is done in JS code, not a matcher schema.

Two distinct global roots: config/instructions/subagents/commands/MCP live in ~/.config/kilo/ (XDG) but global skills live in ~/.kilo/skills/ — do NOT collapse into one dir; ~/.config/kilo/skills is not read.

Rules are not auto-discovered: every extra rule/instruction file must be listed by path or glob in the 'instructions' array of kilo.jsonc; placing a file in .kilo/rules/ alone is a silent no-op (only legacy .kilocode/rules/ auto-loads).

Skills: keep only Agent-Skills-spec frontmatter (name, description, license, compatibility, metadata) — drop tool-specific keys (allowed-tools, model). Set name == directory name (docs contradict themselves; matching is the only safe choice). Validate: name ≤64 chars, [a-z0-9-], no leading/trailing/consecutive hyphens; description ≤1024 chars; compatibility ≤500 chars. Strip !`cmd` shell placeholders from project-deployed skills (never execute outside trusted dirs).

Subagent/MCP renames: agent 'tools' list → 'permission' object of allow|ask|deny, and add mode:'subagent' (default 'all' exposes it as a primary agent). MCP: merge command+args into one 'command' argv array, rename env→environment, add explicit type:'local'|'remote', use 'mcp' key not 'mcpServers', replace alwaysAllow/disabled with enabled + permission rules.

Trust model: {env:VAR} and {file:...} resolve ONLY in trusted config (global ~/.config/kilo, KILO_CONFIG, MDM) — project kilo.jsonc silently ignores {env:} with a warning, so project-scoped translations must inline values or relocate to global; external symlinks for agents/commands/skills need permission.markdown_source allow rules in global config.

global_dir: ~/.hermes (HERMES_HOME; overridable via HERMES_HOME env var; named profiles each get their own HERMES_HOME)

dirs: skills.external_dirs in config.yaml (read/scan; mutated in place by the agent; local dir wins name collisions)

hooks.config_file: ~/.hermes/config.yaml (hooks: key; shell hooks run in CLI + gateway)
hooks.format: YAML flat list per event: {matcher (optional regex vs tool NAME, pre/post_tool_call only), command (required, shlex.split shell=False), timeout (seconds, cap 300), fail_closed/failClosed (pre_tool_call only)}; consent allowlist at ~/.hermes/shell-hooks-allowlist.json; stdout JSON {action|decision: block, message|reason}, {context} on pre_llm_call, exit code 2 blocks pre_tool_call

subagents: Not folder-based: delegate_task tool (goal + context) spawns a fresh AIAgent with isolated context; no agents/ directory, no markdown files, no frontmatter. A canonical .agents/agents/ store has no Hermes target; observability only via subagent_start/subagent_stop hooks.
commands: No custom slash-command directory. Every installed skill is automatically a slash command (/<skill-name> [args], stackable up to 5); skill-bundles add /<bundle-name>. hermes import-agent explicitly skips Claude commands/*.md ('convert them into skills'). Slash commands must be rewritten as SKILL.md skills; $ARGUMENTS-style substitution has no documented equivalent.
rules: No dedicated rules directory. .cursorrules and .cursor/rules/*.mdc are consumed only as the lowest-priority project context file (CWD only, and only when no .hermes.md/HERMES.md/AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md exists). Standing rules otherwise live in SOUL.md (global personality), agent.coding_instructions in config.yaml, or skills.

mcp.format: YAML (mcp_servers: key, snake_case — NOT mcpServers); global only, no project-level MCP file
mcp.shape: mcp_servers: {<name>: {command, args, env} OR {url, headers, auth: oauth, transport: sse}; plus ssl_verify, client_cert/client_key, enabled, timeout, connect_timeout, keepalive_interval, supports_parallel_tool_calls, skip_preflight, idle_timeout_seconds, max_lifetime_seconds, tools: {include, exclude, resources, prompts} (fnmatch, include wins), sampling, elicitation, trust: full|untrusted; env refs ${VAR} and ${env:VAR} (also ${userHome}/${workspaceFolder}); secrets in ~/.hermes/.env; OAuth tokens cached in ~/.hermes/mcp-tokens/<server>.json}

hazards: No project config at all: all settings are global-to-profile in ONE file ~/.hermes/config.yaml (YAML); merge MCP servers/hooks/skill settings into it tolerating unrelated keys; project repos can only carry context files; never sync workspace .hermes/plans/ (agent output).

MCP rename mcpServers -> mcp_servers; drop the type:stdio/http discriminator (implicit command vs url; transport: sse for SSE); strip Hermes-only server keys on export (tools include/exclude, trust, sampling, elicitation, enabled, skip_preflight, keepalive/lifecycle, supports_parallel_tool_calls); keep secrets as ${VAR}/${env:VAR} refs (Hermes strips *_TOKEN/*_API_KEY/Authorization values on import).

Only ONE project context file type loads per session (.hermes.md/HERMES.md > AGENTS.md > CLAUDE.md > .cursorrules): merge CLAUDE.md content into AGENTS.md, never parallel files; strip @import lines (no include syntax); progressive subdir files capped at 8,000 chars each, startup files at context_file_max_chars (floor 20k).

Skills are global-only (~/.hermes/skills/ or skills.external_dirs — external dirs are mutated in place by Hermes, local wins collisions): drop Claude allowed-tools (no Hermes equivalent); Hermes-only keys (platforms, metadata.hermes.*, required_environment_variables, required_credential_files) dropped for other targets; enforce name regex ^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]*$, description <=60 chars, platforms value macos not darwin; strip ${HERMES_SKILL_DIR}/${HERMES_SESSION_ID} tokens and !`...` inline shell on export.

Hook event renames to snake_case (PreToolUse->pre_tool_call, UserPromptSubmit->pre_llm_call, SessionStart->on_session_start, Stop~=pre_verify NOT equivalent, Notification~=pre_approval_request); flat YAML list per event with matcher = regex on tool NAME only and command shlex.split shell=False (pipes/redirects break — wrap in scripts); stdin envelope lacks transcript_path (event data buried in extra{}); context injection is {context:...} not hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext; first-use consent gate per (event, command) requires allowlist approval or hooks_auto_accept/HERMES_ACCEPT_HOOKS=1.

Slash commands and subagent definitions have no Hermes target: commands/*.md must be converted to SKILL.md skills (Hermes' own importer refuses them); .agents/agents/*.md dropped entirely; SOUL.md/MEMORY.md/USER.md are Hermes-only global files — exclude from canonical sync or map global CLAUDE.md content to memories/MEMORY.md.

hooks.config_file: settings.json (top-level "hooks" key in ~/.qoder/settings.json, .qoder/settings.json, .qoder/settings.local.json; merged across tiers; plugins use hooks/hooks.json)

subagents: .qoder/agents/*.md and ~/.qoder/agents/*.md; Markdown + YAML frontmatter, body = system prompt; required keys name, description; optional tools, disallowedTools, mcpServers, model, effort, permissionMode, maxTurns, timeoutMins, temperature, initialPrompt, skills, memory, background, isolation, kind, hooks, color; filename irrelevant (frontmatter name authoritative); unknown keys ignored; precedence Built-in < User < Project < Plugin < --agents flag (project beats user)
commands: .qoder/commands/**/*.md and ~/.qoder/commands/**/*.md; Markdown + YAML frontmatter; description required, name display-only (invocation = file path); subdirs namespace with ':' (git/commit.md -> /git:commit); a SKILL.md in a commands dir suppresses sibling .md files; user-level overrides project-level; only Prompt-type commands extensible
rules: .qoder/rules/**/*.md and ~/.qoder/rules/**/*.md; plain Markdown with optional YAML frontmatter; keys trigger (always_on|manual|model_decision|glob), alwaysApply (compat alias), description (required for model_decision), glob (required for trigger: glob), paths (alias for trigger: glob + glob); no frontmatter = always active; globs gitignore-style; live file-watched

mcp.file: .mcp.json (project root, requires top-level mcpServers) plus mcpServers key in ~/.qoder/settings.json, .qoder/settings.json, .qoder/settings.local.json; override order user -> project settings.json -> .mcp.json -> settings.local.json -> --mcp-config CLI arg
mcp.shape: mcpServers: { "<name>": { command?, args?, env?, cwd? (stdio, default), url?, type: sse|http|streamable-http|ws|sdk, tcp? (ws), headers?, timeout (MILLISECONDS), description?, trust?, includeTools?/excludeTools? (camelCase), disabled?, alwaysAllow?, oauth? } }; ${VAR} env expansion IS supported (resolved at runtime); project servers need per-server approval (mcp.enableAllProjectMcpServers / mcp.enabledProjectMcpServers)

hazards: Layout split: AGENTS.md, AGENTS.local.md, and .mcp.json live at the PROJECT ROOT, not under .qoder/; only .agents/skills is consumed natively (enabled by default since v1.1.11) — canonical agents/, commands/, rules/ must be materialized under .qoder/
Skill frontmatter must be stripped to exactly name + description — drop Claude keys allowed-tools/license/metadata; enforce name=[a-z0-9-]+ max 64 chars, description max 1024 chars

Precedence inversion: USER-level wins name conflicts for skills and commands, but PROJECT-level wins for subagents — a canonical project sync can be silently shadowed by a same-name user skill; never apply one shadowing rule globally

Hooks have no standalone file: they are merged JSON under the "hooks" key in settings.json (edit without clobbering other keys); 16 Qoder-only events (PostToolUseFailure, PermissionRequest, StopFailure, InstructionsLoaded, ConfigChange, CwdChanged, FileChanged, WorktreeCreate/Remove, Elicitation(Result), TaskCreated/Completed, TeammateIdle, Setup, PostCompact, PermissionDenied) must be dropped when retargeting; rename CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR -> QODER_PROJECT_DIR; drop hook types prompt/agent and entry fields if/async/once/args/shell when retargeting

Key-name/case flips per surface: subagent frontmatter permissionMode is camelCase (acceptEdits/bypassPermissions/dontAsk) but settings.json uses snake_case; agent-frontmatter mcpServers uses snake_case include_tools/exclude_tools but settings.json MCP uses camelCase includeTools/excludeTools; rules: rename Cursor globs -> glob (or paths), and model_decision without non-empty description or glob-trigger without glob silently disables the rule

Folder Trust (default on) gates ALL project-level config, and new project MCP servers trigger per-server approval prompts — freshly synced .qoder/ and .mcp.json content silently won't load/activate until the workspace is trusted and servers approved; subagent files need matching frontmatter name since filename is ignored

commands: Project dir `.cursor/commands/<name>.md`, invoked via `/` in Agent; plugin bundles also accept commands/ (.md/.mdc/.markdown/.txt) with frontmatter limited to `name` + `description`. No Claude-style `argument-hint`/`allowed-tools` keys. User-level commands exist conceptually (per /migrate-to-skills) but their on-disk path is undocumented. Official migration direction: convert commands to skills with `disable-model-invocation: true`.
hazards: Skills: rename legacy `globs` -> `paths`; drop Claude-only keys (`allowed-tools`, `license` — not documented for Cursor); `name` must equal parent folder name in lowercase [a-z0-9-] (re-folder on mismatch); SKILL.md must live at `<folder>/SKILL.md`, never a bare `<name>.md`; keep Cursor-native `metadata`/`disable-model-invocation`/`user-invocable`

Hook events: map PascalCase/Claude names to lowerCamelCase (PreToolUse->preToolUse, PostToolUse->postToolUse, UserPromptSubmit->beforeSubmitPrompt, Stop->stop, SubagentStop->subagentStop, SessionStart->sessionStart, SessionEnd->sessionEnd, PreCompact->preCompact); Claude `Notification`/`PermissionRequest` have NO Cursor equivalent — drop

Hook config shape: unwrap Claude nested `[{matcher, hooks:[{type,command}]}]` into flat `[{command, matcher, timeout, loop_limit, failClosed}]` entries directly under `hooks.<event>`; add top-level `"version": 1`; `matcher` is a bare regex string on the entry, not a wrapper object

Hook wire format: stdin envelope uses `conversation_id`/`generation_id`/`hook_event_name`/`cursor_version`/`workspace_roots` (not Claude's session_id-centric envelope), `file_path`+`edits[]` for edits, `command` for shell, object-form `tool_input`, JSON-stringified `tool_output`; stdout is snake_case (`permission`/`user_message`/`agent_message`/`updated_input`/`followup_message`/`additional_context`), not Claude's `hookSpecificOutput` nesting; `ask` is unenforced for preToolUse and treated as `deny` for subagentStart; exit code 2 = deny

Hook paths & matcher names: project-hook commands run from the project root, so script paths must be `.cursor/hooks/x.sh` (a canonical `./hooks/x.sh` resolves wrong); rename tools `Bash`->`Shell`, `Edit`->`Write`; MCP matchers use `MCP:<tool_name>`; `Glob`/`WebFetch`/`WebSearch` matchers unsupported — drop or fold into matcherless preToolUse

Rules: files must be renamed `.md` -> `.mdc` (plain `.md`/`.markdown` in `.cursor/rules/` is silently ignored); frontmatter limited to Cursor's triple `description`, `globs` (comma-separated STRING, not list), `alwaysApply` (bool) — drop all other keys; keep bodies < 500 lines. Also: AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md must be frontmatter-free plain markdown (strip any YAML frontmatter)

hooks.format: { "version": 1, "hooks": { "<event>": [ { "command": string (required), "type": "command"|"prompt", "timeout": seconds, "loop_limit": number|null (default 5), "failClosed": bool (default false), "matcher": string regex } ] } } — flat hook-def entries directly under hooks.<event>; prompt-type hooks use `prompt` (with $ARGUMENTS) + optional `model` instead of `command`. Docs conflict: examples show matcher as string, one table types it object — string form is de facto correct.

mcp.shape: {"mcpServers": {"<name>": stdio {type:"stdio", command (req), args[], env{}, envFile — stdio only} | remote {url, headers{}, auth{CLIENT_ID (req), CLIENT_SECRET, scopes[]}}}}; interpolation ${env:NAME}, ${userHome}, ${workspaceFolder}, ${workspaceFolderBasename}, ${pathSeparator}, ${/} in command/args/env/url/headers

rules: `.cursor/rules/*.mdc` ONLY — plain .md/.markdown in that dir are silently ignored; nested subfolders allowed. Frontmatter: `description` (string), `globs` (comma-separated string), `alwaysApply` (bool). Matrix: alwaysApply:true → always included; globs → auto-attach on file match; description only → agent-decides; neither → manual @rule-name mention. Precedence Team → Project → User. User Rules are settings-UI text, not files; Team Rules are dashboard-managed. `.cursorrules` at root is legacy/deprecating. `@filename.ext` mentions pull files into rule context. Keep rules < 500 lines.
subagents: Supported (2.4+). Dirs: `.cursor/agents/` (project), `~/.cursor/agents/` (user); compat `.claude/agents/`, `.codex/agents/` (+ ~ variants). One markdown file per subagent: YAML frontmatter + prompt body. Keys: `name` (optional, defaults from filename; lowercase+hyphens), `description` (optional; drives Task-tool delegation), `model` (optional; `inherit` or `id[param=value]` e.g. claude-opus-5[effort=high,context=300k]), `readonly` (bool, default false), `is_background` (bool, default false). NO `tools` key (Claude tool allowlists undocumented). Cursor-unique: model bracket syntax, readonly, is_background. Precedence: project > user; `.cursor/` beats compat dirs on name conflict. Built-ins: Explore, Bash, Browser.

hooks.format: JSON object: top-level event name maps directly to an array of hook defs {type:"command", command, matcher?:{tool_name:<regex>}, timeout?:ms(default 10000), description?}; no Claude-style nested matcher/hooks wrapper; ~/.mastracode/hooks.json runs first, .mastracode/hooks.json appended

subagents: Not file-based: no .mastracode/agents/ dir. Built-in Explore/Plan/Execute; overridden programmatically via createMastraCode({subagents:[{id,name,description,instructions}]}); per-agent-type model defaults set via /subagents persisted in settings.json -> models.subagentModels
commands: Supported: recursive .md prompt templates in .mastracode/commands/ -> .claude/commands/ -> .opencode/command/ (project), then ~/. mirrors; frontmatter keys name/description/namespace/goal; subdirs namespace with colons (git/commit.md -> /git:commit); template vars $ARGUMENTS, $1/$2, @filename, `!command`
rules: Not supported: no rules dir or .mdc-style mechanism in the CLI (the monorepo's Factory server product has rules, but that is not the mastracode CLI). Closest equivalents: AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md instructions and skills

mcp.file: .mastracode/mcp.json (highest) > .mcp.json (project root) > ~/.mastracode/mcp.json > .claude/settings.local.json (top-level mcpServers key; lowest); merged by server name
mcp.shape: stdio {command (req), args?, env?} OR HTTP {url (req), headers?, oauth?{redirectUrl XOR callbackPort, clientName?, scopes?, clientId?, clientSecret?}}; both command+url or neither = server skipped; no type/transport field; ${VAR}/${VAR:-default}/$VAR expanded in env/header/url values

hazards: Skills: only name/description/license/compatibility/user-invocable/metadata survive; drop Claude keys (allowed-tools, disable-model-invocation, context, agent, model) - silently discarded
Skills: name must be 1-64 chars lowercase [a-z0-9-], no leading/trailing/double hyphens, and equal the directory name; description <=1024 chars; layout <skillsdir>/<name>/SKILL.md

Hooks: reformat to flat event->array shape; Claude's nested [{matcher:<string>,hooks:[...]}] must be flattened and matcher becomes {tool_name:<regex>} (regex not glob; tool names differ, e.g. execute_command not Bash)
Hooks: unmappable events dropped (no PreCompact/Setup/etc.); mastracode-only events AgentStart/AgentEnd/PermissionRequest/PermissionResult/Interrupt have no Claude equivalent

Hooks: stdin envelope is snake_case (session_id/cwd/hook_event_name/run_id/tool_name/tool_input/...), no transcript_path; blocking via exit code 2 + stdout {decision:allow|block,reason,additionalContext}, not Claude's permissionDecision/hookSpecificOutput
Subagents and rules have no file-based target - canonical .agents/agents/* and rules dirs must be folded into instructions/skills or dropped

subagents: Markdown + YAML frontmatter at project `.gemini/agents/*.md` and user `~/.gemini/agents/*.md` (extensions can also bundle). Frontmatter keys: name (required, lowercase [a-z0-9_-] only), description (required), kind (local|remote), tools (array, wildcards `*`/`mcp_*`/`mcp_<server>_*`, omitted = inherit), mcpServers (inline per-agent), model (default `inherit`), temperature (0.0-2.0, default 1), max_turns (default 30), timeout_mins (default 10). Body = system prompt. Behind experimental.enableAgents (on by default).
commands: Custom slash commands as TOML `.toml` files (NOT Markdown) in project `.gemini/commands/` and user `~/.gemini/commands/`; project wins name conflicts. Fields: prompt (required string), description (optional). Templating: {{args}} placeholder, !{shell} output injection, @{path} file/dir injection. Subdirs namespace with `:` separator (commands/git/commit.toml -> /git:commit).
rules: Not supported: no rules directory. Instructional rules fold into GEMINI.md context files. Distinct Policy Engine uses TOML [[rules]] blocks (toolName, decision/action, commandPrefix, subagent, deny_message) from ~/.gemini/policies/ + policyPaths — a tool-permission engine, not prompt content; keep out of instructions sync.

mcp.file: settings.json (any layer; no standalone .mcp.json for the CLI itself — caveat: docs reference an mcp_config.json for standard MCP clients / remote skills env passthrough)
mcp.shape: Top-level `mcpServers` object keyed by server name, plus sibling `mcp` globals (serverCommand, allowed, excluded). Server entry: one of command (stdio) | url (SSE) | httpUrl (streamable HTTP) required; optional args, env, cwd, timeout (ms, default 600000), trust, includeTools/excludeTools (exclude wins), headers, OAuth fields (targetAudience, targetServiceAccount, authProviderType). env values support $VAR/${VAR} (%VAR% Windows-only). Tools surface as mcp_<server>_<tool>.

hazards: Commands are TOML not Markdown: convert canonical md command body -> `prompt` string, description -> `description`, rewrite $ARGUMENTS -> {{args}}, drop md frontmatter keys (allowed-tools, argument-hint have no TOML v1 equivalent)

Hook event renames: PreToolUse->BeforeTool, PostToolUse->AfterTool, UserPromptSubmit->BeforeAgent, Stop->AfterAgent, PreCompact->PreCompress; Gemini-only BeforeModel/AfterModel/BeforeToolSelection cannot round-trip to Claude-style peers

Hook matchers are regex against Gemini tool names (write_file, read_file, run_shell_command, mcp_<server>_<tool>) — Claude tool names (Write, Edit, Bash) never match; rewrite matcher values, not just event names
Hooks and MCP servers live inside JSON settings.json under `hooks` / `mcpServers` keys — merge into settings JSON preserving siblings; never sync standalone hook files or .mcp.json

Strip skill frontmatter beyond name/description (allowed-tools, license, metadata, compatibility are parsed-then-discarded, inert); sanitize skill names: chars `: \ / < > * ? " |` -> `-`; discovery only SKILL.md or */SKILL.md (one level deep)

Instructions: rename canonical file to GEMINI.md (or set context.fileName in settings.json to read AGENTS.md); `@path` lines are live import directives — preserve or inline them, never treat as plain links; subagent `name` must be lowercase [a-z0-9_-] (rename uppercase/dotted canonical names)

hooks.config_file: none (no hooks setting; equivalent is TypeScript plugins in .amp/plugins/ or ~/.config/amp/plugins/)
hooks.format: none (no shell-command hooks, no stdin JSON envelope; in-process JS/TS plugin handlers registered via amp.on())

subagents: No file-based subagent format. Built-in subagents auto-spawned; custom subagents only via plugin code (amp.createAgent + amp.registerTool). Built-in named tools: Oracle, Librarian, Painter.
commands: Removed as of 2026-01-29 ('Custom commands are gone. Use skills instead.'). Former .agents/commands/<name>.md must migrate to .agents/skills/<name>/SKILL.md with name/description frontmatter; executables move under the skill's scripts/ dir. Remaining commands are plugin-registered command-palette entries (amp.registerCommand), not prompt templates.
rules: No dedicated rules directory/format. Conditional guidance = files @-mentioned from AGENTS.md carrying Amp-specific YAML frontmatter globs: ['**/*.ts']. Distinct concept: review checks at .agents/checks/<name>.md (single files, frontmatter: name (required), description, severity-default (low|medium|high|critical), tools[]), run only during amp review.

mcp.file: amp.mcpServers key inside .amp/settings.json (workspace, searched upward to repo root) or ~/.config/amp/settings.json (user); also --mcp-config CLI flag, amp mcp add CLI, or skill-level mcp.json / SKILL.md mcpServers
mcp.format: JSON/JSONC, name -> server map; all settings keys use amp. prefix
mcp.shape: Local: {command: string, args?: string[], env?: object}; Remote: {url: string, headers?: object}; common: includeTools?: string[] (Amp-specific). Skill mcp.json is the FLAT name->server map with NO top-level mcpServers wrapper (unlike Claude .mcp.json). ${VAR} env interpolation in settings strings. Workspace servers require explicit `amp mcp approve`. Precedence: CLI > workspace > user > skills.

hazards: Hooks: drop or codegen TS plugins in .amp/plugins/ — no shell hooks, no stdin envelope, no matchers; handlers return typed objects ({action:'allow'|'reject-and-continue'|'modify'|'synthesize'|'error'}). No session.end event; Notification/SubagentStop/PreCompact/SessionEnd have no counterpart.
Slash commands removed (2026-01-29): convert each to .agents/skills/<name>/SKILL.md with name+description frontmatter; executable commands become scripts under the skill's scripts/ subdir.
No file-based subagents: canonical subagent definitions can only become plugin code via amp.createAgent; drop or generate a plugin.

Skill frontmatter: keep only name, description, mcpServers — drop Claude-only keys (allowed-tools, license, metadata). Hard rule: skill directory name must equal frontmatter name; SKILL.md sits directly inside the skill dir.

MCP shape mismatch: use amp.mcpServers inside settings.json (not standalone .mcp.json); skill mcp.json must be a FLAT name->server map with no mcpServers wrapper; drop Claude 'type:stdio' field (transport inferred from command vs url); includeTools is Amp-only.

Amp natively reads .agents/skills/ and .agents/checks/ (1:1 mapping for skills), but .agents/commands/ is dead and checks/*.md are single files with Amp-specific frontmatter (severity-default, tools) — not rules. No rules dir exists; do not emit .amp/rules/; conditional rules need @-mentioned files with Amp-only globs: frontmatter.

global_dir: ~/.config/goose/ (config.yaml, permission.yaml, secrets.yaml, settings.json, prompts/); NOTE: global skills/agents/plugins live under ~/.agents/ instead

envelope_fields: tool_output (undocumented; serialized by source but absent from doc table)

subagents: No dedicated subagent file dir/format; spawned dynamically via natural language or recipes (YAML; no id field — documented keys: title & description required, instructions/prompt at least one required, plus activities, extensions, parameters, response, retry, settings, sub_recipes, version) discovered from cwd, GOOSE_RECIPE_PATH dirs, ~/.config/goose/recipes/, ./.goose/recipes/, or GitHub via GOOSE_RECIPE_GITHUB_REPO. Closest file-based equivalent: custom agents — Markdown + YAML frontmatter in ~/.agents/agents/ and <project>/.agents/agents/ (compat: .goose/agents/, .claude/agents/, ~/.goose/agents/, ~/.claude/agents/), frontmatter keys: name (required), description (optional), model (optional, goose-specific).
commands: No markdown prompt-command directory (no .claude/commands analog). Custom slash commands are aliases to recipe YAML declared under `slash_commands:` (command + recipe_path) in global ~/.config/goose/config.yaml; project-level not supported.
rules: Not supported as a distinct concept — no rules dir or rule-file format; role covered by .goosehints/AGENTS.md (session-start + nested), persistent instructions via GOOSE_MOIM_MESSAGE_TEXT/GOOSE_MOIM_MESSAGE_FILE (every-turn, 64 KB cap), and skills.

mcp.shape: Top-level `extensions:` map keyed by extension id; per-extension fields: type (builtin|platform|stdio|streamable_http|frontend|inline_python; legacy sse read-only), name, enabled, bundled, display_name, timeout (s), available_tools (allow-list); stdio adds cmd (string) + args (list); streamable_http adds uri + headers; envs (literal KEY: value map) and env_keys (names resolved from keyring/secrets.yaml/env). No project-level MCP file; provider API keys in config.yaml are ignored by design.

hazards: Hooks require full reformat: wrap into a plugin package (.agents/plugins/<plugin>/plugin.json + hooks/hooks.json, JSON {hooks:{Event:[{matcher,hooks:[{type,command,timeout}]}]}}); matcher is REGEX not glob — a bare "*" is invalid and the rule is silently skipped (use ".*" or omit)

Hook event mapping: SubagentStart/SubagentStop are never emitted and Notification/PreCompact have no equivalent — drop them; PostToolUse fires on success only, so failure handlers must move to goose-only PostToolUseFailure; tool names are namespaced (developer__write, developer__edit, developer__shell), not Write|Edit|Bash

Hook stdin envelope must be renamed: hook_event_name→event, cwd→working_dir; no tool_response field; blocking = exit code 2 (reason on stderr) or {"decision":"block","reason":...} on stdout, and only PreToolUse/Stop can block; Claude's hookSpecificOutput/additionalContext/permissionDecision outputs have no equivalent — drop

Skill frontmatter: drop Claude-only keys (allowed-tools, license — no tool gating equivalent; closest is per-extension available_tools); nest arbitrary metadata under `metadata:` per agentskills.io rather than flattening; enforce name validation (lowercase ASCII letters/digits/hyphens, ≤64 chars, no leading/trailing hyphen); always emit `name` even though source falls back to dir name

Slash commands and rules have no file-sync target: commands are recipe-YAML aliases in global config.yaml only (project-level unsupported — converting a prompt command means authoring recipe YAML + editing global config); rule files must be merged into .goosehints/AGENTS.md or a skill

MCP translation: target is YAML `extensions:` in global ~/.config/goose/config.yaml (no project JSON); rename command→cmd, env→envs (literal, plaintext YAML) and prefer env_keys for secrets (keyring-resolved); map http/sse→streamable_http (sse legacy-only); add goose-required keys name, enabled (no `disabled` flag), bundled, timeout, type; no ${VAR} expansion documented for envs

hooks.config_file: crushrc (`hook add` builtin); legacy crush.json/.crush.json "hooks" object
hooks.format: Bash builtin or JSON; flat entry {name?, matcher?, command, timeout?} (timeout default 30s)

subagents: Not supported as user config: only two hardcoded builtin agents (coder, task); no agents key in schema, no agents dir; drop .claude/agents/*.md equivalents entirely.
commands: Not supported as folder config: no commands key/dir; translate canonical commands to user-invocable skills (SKILL.md with user-invocable: true, surfaced as user:<name>/project:<name> in ctrl+p palette) or drop.
rules: No rules feature of its own: .cursorrules and .cursor/rules/ are just default context paths loaded verbatim into the system prompt; strip Cursor .mdc frontmatter (alwaysApply/globs) before routing; .crushignore is gitignore-syntax file exclusion, not rules.

mcp.file: crushrc (`mcp add` builtin) or legacy crush.json
mcp.format: Bash builtin or JSON top-level `mcp` object (NOT mcpServers)
mcp.shape: {type (required: stdio|sse|http, default stdio), command, args[], env{}, url, headers{}, disabled, disabled_tools[], enabled_tools[], timeout (default 10s), oauth, oauth_client_id, oauth_client_secret, oauth_callback_port}

hazards: No folder-based config dir: project config is root-level files (crushrc/.crushrc/crush.json/.crush.json); .crush/ is machine state (logs, workspace JSON) — never adopt .crush/* wholesale, only .crush/skills is user config; set config_dir=none.

Config format is executable Bash: emit `mcp add`/`hook add`/`option`/`permissions` command lines (or deprecated JSON); no declarative YAML/TOML target; precedence project > global, crushrc > JSON per directory.

MCP table is `mcp`, not mcpServers; per-server `type` is required (stdio|sse|http); drop crush-only keys when translating away (disabled_tools, enabled_tools, timeout, oauth*, disabled); only header values expanding to empty are dropped — env values expanding to empty are KEPT as KEY= (verified correction).

Skills: `name` must equal the containing dir name (case-insensitive) and match ^[a-zA-Z0-9]+(-[a-zA-Z0-9]+)*$ (≤64 chars, no underscores/dots/spaces); description ≤1024, compatibility ≤500; metadata must be flat map[string]string; Claude's allowed-tools is silently ignored (route permissions to `permissions allow` instead); drop crush-unique user-invocable/disable-model-invocation when translating away.

Hooks: only PreToolUse exists — drop PostToolUse/SessionStart/UserPromptSubmit/etc.; flatten Claude's nested hooks:[{type:command,...}] into flat {name?, matcher?, command, timeout?} (timeout default 30s vs Claude 60s); stdin field is `event` (rename from Claude's hook_event_name); output is flat decision/updated_input (snake_case, SHALLOW-merge patch — not Claude's hookSpecificOutput.permissionDecision / updatedInput full-replace); exit 49 (halt turn) is crush-specific.

Subagents and slash commands unsupported as config: drop subagent files entirely; convert commands to user-invocable skills or drop; AGENTS.md is natively read (zero-copy) but so are CLAUDE.md/CRUSH.md/.cursorrules — avoid double-loading; no heading convention and no @import syntax (flatten includes); global instruction files are ~/.config/crush/CRUSH.md and ~/.config/AGENTS.md.
